Image inside an anchor produces a linked image

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<a href="https://example.com"><img src="icon.png" alt="Icon"></a>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
